request: Consolidate Made With These Hands page components into a validated generic Directus block store using the existing site_sections collection, preserving published pages and legacy block collections during migration. Store only declarative component keys, schema versions, content data, and source references. Validate data against the approved registry, render through existing React components, add Storybook migration states, keep migrated acceptance content draft, and require platform approval before schema mutation or production release.

proposal.label: Generic page block storage
proposal.description: A declarative Directus storage envelope that dispatches validated data to existing approved renderers without creating one collection per component.
accessibility: The selected approved renderer retains its accessibility contract.
Unknown component keys fail closed and do not render.
Migration preserves block order, slots, headings, media alternative text, and publication status.
proposal.bespoke_gap: This is a storage and dispatch capability rather than a visual primitive; shadcn components remain selected by each approved renderer.

checks.reason: Slots are inside the tenant page-slot contract.
Slots are inside the tenant page-slot contract.
